title: Missing Permissions-Policy response header
description: The response omits Permissions-Policy. Browser defaults already restrict camera, microphone and geolocation to the top-level origin, so absence does not expose a feature; it removes the ability to narrow access for embedded frames and for features whose default allowlist is broader. The finding is the missing declaration, not an exposed capability.
remediation: Declare the features the application does not use as empty allowlists, for example camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(). Add a directive only where a feature must be delegated to a named origin.
limitation: Header-name check on one response. It cannot see which features the page uses, and default allowlists differ per feature, so absence is a policy gap rather than an observed exposure.
